claims.quote: Type locality: Caño "Sabalito," a small creek on terra firma about 40 kilometers south of Iquitos, Loreto, Peru.
Also recorded at Reserva Florestal Adolfo Ducke, Amazonas State, Brazil.

The type series that originated in the Río Ucayali basin and in the region of Iquitos in northeastern Peru, and the non-type population samples of the species from the Rio Aripuanã in the rio Madeira basin, Brazil agree in all examined features.

A single specimen from the upper Río Napo in eastern Ecuador (ANSP 139105), tentatively identified as Denticetopsis seducta, has a slightly higher number of total vertebrae (43) than the 39 to 42 total vertebrae in the other examined specimens assigned to the species.
